verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing documents its own spend controls: transaction rules that automatically decline authorizations not meeting business requirements, per-card balances, and the ability to permanently close a card. That gives a plausible but thin basis for scoped cards. The evidence never shows a single-use card type or rule criteria for merchant locking or exact amounts. Relayed authorisation would let a developer build that logic, but it is a building block and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented single-use/burner card option, merchant-lock rule criteria, exact-amount limit criteria, auto-expiry after first use, independent or hands-on corroboration.
